verdict.rationale: The evidence says Replicate hosts thousands of community and proprietary models, but nothing documents an API endpoint that lists the model catalog programmatically. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the docs.md and llms.txt probes show no catalog-listing endpoint. The axis clearly applies to a model-hosting API platform, so absent evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
